Subject: POC - success criteria, next steps + final readout scheduling

Hi Alicia -

Thanks again for a productive demo yesterday. Per our discussion, I wanted to summarize next steps for the POC trial and confirm owners/timeline so we can lock the final readout and exec review. Attached is the success criteria workbook we discussed (Aurora_POC_success_criteria.xlsx).

Summary / ask:
- Success criteria (owner):
  - Latency: 95th pctile < 350ms on key call path (owner: Aurora infra)
  - Quality: top-2 intent accuracy >= 92% on sample set (owner: Aurora product)
  - Cost: average per-session token cost <= $0.008 (owner: Aurora finance + Redwood)
- Evaluation plan: Neha to run the integration checklist and validate KV cache behavior; Marcus to provide test harness and traffic pattern script by Fri 7/10.
- Timeline (proposed):
  - Integration & run: 7/9 - 7/13
  - Readout prep: 7/14
  - Exec readout / go/no-go: week of 7/14 (please confirm best slot)
- Final contract step if go: procurement/finance will need an SOW + pricing attachment and DocuSign. Marcus will own pricing; I will own SOW language.

Can you confirm:
1) success criteria look right or any changes?
2) exec review date that works for your leadership team (we're suggesting Tue 7/14 or Thu 7/16, 30 - 45 min)?
3) any additional stakeholders to invite (procurement, legal)?

Thanks - we want to make the final readout concise and give your execs confidence to decide.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Lead, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai
(415) 555-0123

Attachments: Aurora_POC_success_criteria.xlsx (spreadsheet)
